corrections: Added the November 17, 2026 Apple outage (Apple attributed it to an internal update, not an attack; 9to5Mac, Engadget).
AISI figures confirmed: 122 runs, 19 actions in 10 runs, internet access permitted and cyber classifiers disabled, no real-world harm found.
Anthropic campaign: roughly thirty targets, succeeded in a small number of cases, AI performed 80-90% of the campaign; state-sponsored group.
Federal Reserve Barr speech (Nov 16, 2026) confirmed on banks finding agents in retail accounts.

Added an outage timeline: Google Cloud London Oct 20 (generator PLC misconfiguration; Lloyds, HSBC, Royal Mail affected; The Register), Microsoft 365 Nov 12-13 (from 16:17 UTC; 130,000+ Outlook reports; CIO.com), US banks and Zelle Nov 16 (Chase: technical bug, not cyber; CBS News).
